digest.component_or_area: plan-review batch runner pass-1 pass and usage aggregation
propositions: Pass-1 finder functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) discard per-call _usage dicts from runner results, losing token totals and criterion-specific request counts needed for data-driven decisions
Usage attribution must be threaded through the pass1 call chain (sizing.pass1_with_ladder → passes.pass1_chunk/container/isf → runner.run) and returned as coordinated API change to all callers
Multi-criterion chunks must divide token fields equally across covered criteria while llm_calls and requests count in full per criterion; ladder retries each contribute separate call records
BatchRunResult.outputs and coverage.metrics must carry aggregate token totals and per-criterion breakdowns; the sidecar payload must expose raw per-call records under coverage.usage keys

All external pass1 callers (eval_solver.py, criterion_preview.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, prerequisites) must be updated atomically to unpack and handle the new return shapes without breaking existing behavior
